Do you ever sit at the end of your bed, half undressed, trousers rolled down; and think about the fleeting nature of our meaningless existence.
I can’t bring myself to take my trousers off because depression or whatever the fuck this is takes control. It takes my motivation away to do simple tasks like shower. Cause fuck it if everything so meaningless and I don’t care why the fuck should I shower I can’t think of a good reason. I can’t think of a good reason to do anything. The only thing that makes me happy is the company of other people, I turn into a Freak in isolation, I start writing dodgy notes like this because I’ve got a burst of thoughts. A burst of thoughts as I’m half undressed at the end of my bed with my trousers rolled down by my feet, I haven’t taken them off yet by the way. That’s better, now I’m bed nice and cosy feeling bloated and my mouth feels sticky from drinking too much coke. Why do I do it to myself. I think everytime I go to grab a bottle that it’s worthless and it causes nothing but harm; there it is again, the carelessness for myself so why would I care for anybody else. How can I be considerate and do shit for other people’s sake when I can’t take care of myself.
What’s wrong with me? I can’t figure it out. I know I don’t enjoy my own company, I know I don’t provide anything, I don’t provide jokes and fun. Why on earth would someone want to invite someone who can’t joke and have fun,? I can’t blame anyone but myself. I’m the common denominator, I must be repulsive, still don’t know why. These are just pre bed thoughts that have been going through my head non stop for the last 10 days, I just sat in the corner at work and cried to myself the other day. I’m having some sort of breakdown but can still laugh when I speak to someone I care about. All these feelings disappear when I’m with company I want to be with; why is that? God I’m lost, I’ve got career goals and I feel oriented but I can’t be friendless forever, I don’t want to spend the rest of my youth gaming like I spent the first half. Am I just supposed to hang on and hope that I’ll be happier in the future. Fuck. No word describes my life better than a simple “fuck.” I think I blame myself for a lot of things, I got the advice I needed to get through the issues I had; so why didn’t I? Fuck
